about: the workspace agent's conversation (D233): connection, a numbered plan with tags, cards (brief, refusal, redirect, can't, report, failure), request and session by id, questions as rows with Something else over pages, the composer's context, quick replies and hint; the tile's own scope sheet opened from the line and a chip, then dismissed

connection.label: Scope: 14 tiles in 3 orgs connected, 6 not connected. Model big.

json.hint: Say what you want and how you’ll know it’s done. The agent works out the steps.

fields.goal: The CSV export in Orders rounds totals per line since Monday. Round once, on the invoice total.
fields.doneWhen: Monday’s export matches the totals Invoices shows, to the cent.
fields.leaveAlone: The PDF export and the customer links.
fields.checkBy: Running the export tests and comparing three invoices by hand.

scope.modelNote: Finance allows private models only. big is not private.

orgs.name: Finance
orgs.reason: Finance allows private models only (pinned by a workspace admin).

entries.text: The export in Orders is wrong since Monday. Fix it, and check that Invoices still adds up.

entries.note: Saying go ahead starts step 1. It does not approve steps 3, 5: each asks when it is reached.

steps.text: Look at Orders’ export and Monday’s change
Have Orders’ own agent fix the rounding
Rebuild the customer links in Invoices
Compare Monday’s totals in both tiles

entries.title: Brief for Orders’ agent
entries.note: This is what the tile agent is told first. What your agent sends it later isn’t approved message by message: the tile agent asks you before it acts.

entries.title: Ledger is blocked by a rule
entries.text: Finance allows private models only. This session is on big, which is not private, so Ledger isn’t connected.
entries.note: This is a rule set by an admin, not something the agent can work around.

entries.title: The workspace agent doesn’t open or edit code

ways.title: Hand this to Orders’ own agent
ways.text: It opens in Orders with your message as written.

ways.title: Tell me the outcome instead
ways.text: “Totals in the export should match Invoices.”

entries.text: Deleting a tile is yours to do yourself, from the tile’s ⋯ menu. It can show you where it is and what still uses it.

entries.title: The export is fixed
entries.body: **Monday’s totals match again.** Orders’ agent rounds once, on the invoice total.

lines.text: Checked: the export tests pass, and three invoices match by hand.

entries.title: Team calendar’s agent couldn’t continue
entries.text: xbin was updated at 09:40 and it did not come back. Its transcript is kept. Start it again?
